ab: The fastest sprint locomotion. Most balanced and the standard state of Regalis with no positives or negatives.

Deals medium damage. Less powerful than Headbash, but delivers higher sustained DPS.
Able to eat berries and fruit, moderate food drain.
Ignore uphill movement decrease, increases speed when moving downhill by 10%, and reduces falling damage by 10%.

A call that increases all group members attack damage by 20% within 50 meters for 60 seconds.
A rallying call that reduces incoming fracture by half for you and all nearby group members within 50 meters for 60 seconds.

Rapidly turn to face behind you and change your direction.
